requires.n: Creature Castable for One Colored Mana

678-2324-5670--52.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
678-2324-5670--52.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing the nontoken creature that can be cast using one colored mana.
When the creature dies, Proper Burial and Enduring Renewal trigger.
Resolve the Proper Burial trigger, causing you to gain life
Resolve the Enduring Renewal trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Cast the creature by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

339-677-3899-5434.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

622-5702-7824.easyPrerequisites: You control a Forest that enters the battlefield untapped.
622-5702-7824.description:
Animate a Forest that enters untapped using Kamahl
Cast Springheart Nantuko for its bestow cost by paying {1}{G}, attaching it to the animated Forest.
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of the Forest that enters untapped.
When the Forest tokens enter, Springheart Nantuko triggers twice.
Holding priority, activate the Forest tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Resolve the first Springheart Nantuko trigger, choosing not to pay and creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Resolve the second Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of the Forest that enters untapped.
Repeat from step 4.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

1115-2447-3259.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
1115-2447-3259.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Infestation Expert // Infested Werewolf as attackers.
Infestation Expert // Infested Werewolf triggers, creating at least one creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

2103-4423-6886-7705.easyPrerequisites:
You control three other Islands.
There is another nonbasic land on the battlefield.
2103-4423-6886-7705.description:
Cast Capture of Jingzhou by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Dust Bowl by paying {3}, tapping it and sacrificing Mystic Sanctuary, destroying a nonbasic land.
Play Mystic Sanctuary from your graveyard.
When Mystic Sanctuary enters untapped, it triggers, putting Capture of Jingzhou from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Move to your next turn, drawing Capture of Jingzhou during your draw step.
Repeat.

4506-6996-7690--165.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
4506-6996-7690--165.description:
Gain life.
The Destined White Mage triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the other Hero.
Invisible Woman triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Auriok Champion triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

4050-4840-4853-7452.description:
Activate Cauldron of Essence by paying {1}{B}{G}, tapping it and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Cauldron of Essence triggers, and Dross Scorpion triggers if the creature was an artifact.
Resolve the Cauldron of Essence trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Dross Scorpion trigger, if applicable, untapping an artifact.
Resolve the Cauldron of Essence ability from step 1, returning Myr Battlesphere from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Myr Battlesphere enters, it triggers, creating four creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar three times by sacrificing Myr Battlesphere and two tokens, adding {1}{B}{G}.
When Myr Battlesphere and the tokens die, Dross Scorpion triggers three times, untapping Cauldron of Essence and two other artifacts.
Repeat.

1018-2103-5144.description:
Cast Capture of Jingzhou by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Ephemerate by paying {W}, blinking Skullwinder and exiling Ephemerate.
When Skullwinder enters, it triggers, returning Capture of Jingzhou from your graveyard to your hand.
Move to your next turn. At the beginning of your upkeep, Ephemerate's rebound ability triggers, causing you to cast it from exile without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Ephemerate, blinking Skullwinder.
When Skullwinder enters, it triggers, returning Ephemerate from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

77-1133-1825.easyPrerequisites:
You control up to five lands that can tap to produce at least {U}{U}.
It is your upkeep step.
77-1133-1825.description:
During your upkeep, activate up to five lands by tapping them, adding at least {U}{U}.
Activate Hakim's first ability by paying {U}{U}, returning Treachery from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Hakim.
When Treachery enters, it triggers, untapping up to five lands.
Activate Faith Healer by sacrificing Treachery.
Repeat.

1115-2713-3094-4659-7344.easyPrerequisites: You have an artifact card in your graveyard.
1115-2713-3094-4659-7344.description:
Cast Brilliance Unleashed by paying {4}{U}{R}. Choose its second mode, targeting any artifact card in your graveyard.
Holding priority, activate Lithoform Engine's second ability by paying {1} due to Zirda and tapping it, targeting Brilliance Unleashed.
Holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Lithoform Engine, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Lithoform Engine ability, copying Brilliance Unleashed, targeting Lithoform Engine.
Resolve the copy of Brilliance Unleashed, returning Lithoform Engine from your graveyard to the battlefield as a 3/3 Robot artifact creature.
Repeat from step 2.

792-2921-7084.easyPrerequisites:
You control a land.
You control another nonland creature.
792-2921-7084.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing another nonland creature.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, Totentanz and Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger.
Resolve the Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Totentanz trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat.

2292-4871-5220-5946.notablePrerequisites:
You control a nontoken creature that can be cast using one colored mana.
You control at least three creatures with different powers.
2292-4871-5220-5946.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing the nontoken creature.
When the creature dies, Mortuary and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting the creature from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Cast the creature from the top of your library by paying its mana cost
Repeat.

2459-4050-5220-6900.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Rograkh
When Rograkh dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Rograkh from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Cast Rograkh from the top of your library by paying 0 life.
Repeat.

1563-2457-4359-4772.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Activate the Insects by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: Birgi, God of Storytelling // Harnfel, Horn of Bounty

1-392-1786-6282.notablePrerequisites:
You have a card in hand.
Your life total is at least 2.
1-392-1786-6282.description:
Activate Birgi, God of Storytelling // Harnfel, Horn of Bounty by discarding a card.
Containment Construct triggers, exiling the discarded card with the ability to play it until end of turn.
Ketramose triggers, causing you to draw a card and lose 1 life.
Queza triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and an opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Birgi, God of Storytelling // Harnfel, Horn of Bounty ability.
Repeat.

719-1429-3698-5402.notablePrerequisites: Lesser Masticore does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
719-1429-3698-5402.description:
Activate Grinding Station by tapping it and sacrificing Lesser Masticore.
When Lesser Masticore dies,  its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Lesser Masticore enters the battlefield, Captain Storm and Grinding Station trigger.
Resolve the Captain Storm trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on Lesser Masticore.
Resolve the Grinding Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Grinding Station ability from step 1.
Repeat.

uses.exileCardState: with a takeover counter on it

2092-3719-4284-5326.notablePrerequisites: Clone and Agatha of the Vile Cauldron each have a power of at least 2.
2092-3719-4284-5326.description:
Cast The Master by paying {U}{B}.
When The Master enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice Clone and create at least two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Activate The Master by paying {B} and sacrificing a Treasure, returning Clone from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of The Master, which causes the Clone to be a copy of Ruthless Technomancer.
When Clone enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice The Master and create two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Activate Clone by paying {B} and sacrificing a Treasure, returning The Master from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Ruthless Technomancer.
Repeat from step 2.

2092-3263-4929-5140.description:
Activate Kenrith's second ability by paying {1}, putting a +1/+1 counter on Cryptic Trilobite.
Activate Cryptic Trilobite's first ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {C}{C} that can only be spent to activate abilities.
Repeat.
2092-3263-4929-5140.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may spend it on Kenrith's other abilities.

3484-4770-5674.notablePrerequisites: You have at least {E} or enough mana to cast Whitemane Lion
3484-4770-5674.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying {E} due to Primal Prayers, if able, or by paying its mana cost.
When Whitemane Lion enters the battlefield, it and Decoction Module trigger.
Resolve the Decoction Module trigger, causing you to get {E}.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

276-791-3693-5426.notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to give Walking Ballista lifelink.
Walking Ballista has at least two +1/+1 counters on it, or your life total is at least 4.
276-791-3693-5426.description:
Cast Insult by paying {2}{R}, doubling all damage dealt by sources you control this turn.
Give Walking Ballista lifelink, if needed.
If Walking Ballista has less than two +1/+1 counters on it, activate Unspeakable Symbol by paying 3 life, putting a +1/+1 counter on Walking Ballista.
Activate Walking Ballista's second ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 4 damage to an opponent or a permanent an opponent controls, and causing you to gain 4 life.
Repeat from step 3.

301-1142-2034-4350.description:
Activate Lazav by paying {2}, choosing to have it become a copy of Putrid Goblin if it doesn't have a -1/-1 counter on it, or Butcher Ghoul otherwise.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Lazav, adding {C}{C}.
When Lazav dies, if it was a copy of Putrid Goblin, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Otherwise, Lazav's undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Lazav enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to surveil 1.
Repeat.

2438-3565-4424.notablePrerequisites: You have at least one blue card in hand.
2438-3565-4424.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Dragon's Eye Savants.
When Dragon's Eye Savants dies, Missy's first ability triggers, returning Dragon's Eye Savants from your graveyard to the battlefield face down as a 2/2 Cyberman artifact creature.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Dragon's Eye Savants's morph ability by revealing a blue card from your hand, turning it face up.
Repeat.

1424-3330-3957.notablePrerequisites:
Presence of Gond attached to Famished Paladin.
Famished Paladin does not have summoning sickness.
1424-3330-3957.description:
Activate Famished Paladin by tapping it, creating a 1/1 Elf Warrior creature token.
When the Elf Warrior enters the battlefield, Leyline of Vitality triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Famished Paladin triggers, untapping itself.
Repeat.

732-1013-1636-4939.notablePrerequisites:
Hypervolt Grasp attached to Felhide Spiritbinder.
Felhide Spiritbinder does not have summoning sickness.
732-1013-1636-4939.description:
Activate Felhide Spiritbinder by tapping it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Cast Burning-Tree Emissary by paying {R/G}{R/G}.
When Burning-Tree Emissary enters the battlefield, it and Intruder Alarm trigger.
Resolve the Burning-Tree Emissary trigger, adding {R}{G}.
Resolve the Intruder Alarm trigger, untapping all creatures.
Felhide Spiritbinder triggers, holding priority, activate it by tapping it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Resolve the Felhide Spiritbinder trigger, causing you to pay {1}{R} to create a token copy of Burning-Tree Emissary with haste.
Repeat from step 3.

3430-4289-5137.notablePrerequisites: Morphling does not have summoning sickness.
3430-4289-5137.description:
Activate Morphling by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Morphling's first ability by paying {U}, untapping it.
Repeat.
